finance.title: Verizon mobile service down for thousands of customers in the U.S., Downdetector shows
finance.summary: Verizon recommended that customers who are still impacted by the outage restart their devices. The company did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.

finance.summary_cn: Verizon建议仍受停电影响的客户重新启动设备。该公司没有提供停电的原因。

finance.title: Hunter Biden says Joe Biden’s cancer has spread further and is ‘very painful’
finance.summary: "The cancer has spread, is metastasized into his bones and further. It's very painful. It's very debilitating in many respects," Hunter Biden said.

finance.summary_cn: “癌症已经扩散，转移到他的骨头中，甚至进一步。非常痛苦。这在很多方面都非常令人衰弱，”亨特·拜登说。

finance.title: Elevator giant Otis wants to be a defensive play in an volatile market. It has to prove itself first
finance.summary: Otis positions itself as a long-term growth stock, but shares are down due to setbacks in its elevator service business and investors chasing the AI trade.
finance.title_cn: 电梯巨头奥的斯希望在动荡的市场中成为防御型公司。它必须首先证明自己
finance.summary_cn: 奥的斯将自己定位为长期成长股，但由于电梯服务业务的挫折和投资者追逐人工智能贸易，股价下跌。

finance.title: A record-breaking week for options powers S&P 500 surge; volatility gauge is near 2026 low
finance.summary: The broad market benchmark soared to records this week, benefiting from options activity and a calmer VIX.
finance.title_cn: 期权创纪录的一周推动标准普尔500指数飙升;波动率指标接近2026年低点
finance.summary_cn: 受益于期权活动和波动率指数趋于平静，整体市场基准本周飙升至创纪录水平。

finance.title: ‘SaaSpocalypse’ debate intensifies as software stocks swing wildly
finance.summary: This week saw massive moves in both directions for software stocks, as investors try to figure out which names are best insulated from artificial intelligence.
finance.title_cn: 随着软件股剧烈波动，“SaaSpocalypse”争论加剧
finance.summary_cn: 本周，软件股在两个方向上都出现了大幅波动，投资者试图找出哪些公司最能与人工智能隔绝。

ai.title: Added Courses at Chandigarh University Uttar Pradesh, AI, Business Analytics & More to Boost Student Skills
ai.description: Chandigarh [India], August 8: Chandigarh University Uttar Pradesh has integrated 12 value-added courses into its academic curriculum. These credit-based courses aim to equip students with additional skills alongside their degree, addressing demands in both the current job market and higher education. Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Design Thinking and IoT will now become part of regular curriculum for students.
ai.title_cn: 昌迪加尔大学增加北方邦、人工智能、商业分析等课程，以提高学生技能
ai.description_cn: 钱迪加尔[印度]，8月8日：钱迪加尔大学北方邦已将12门增值课程融入其学术课程。这些基于学分的课程旨在让学生在获得学位的同时还掌握额外技能，以满足当前就业市场和高等教育的需求。人工智能、商业分析、设计思维和物联网现在将成为学生常规课程的一部分。

ai.title: Ampcus Cyber Convenes National Leaders at GRC India AI Conclave 2026 to Advance AI Governance, Cybersecurity, and Digital Trust
ai.description: New Delhi [India], August 8: Ampcus Cyber, a global cybersecurity solutions provider, successfully hosted the GRC India AI Conclave 2026 on 7th August at JW Marriott, Aerocity, New Delhi, bringing together policymakers, government officials, regulators, cybersecurity leaders, CXOs, technology experts, and industry practitioners to deliberate on the future of AI governance, cyber resilience, governance, risk and compliance (GRC), and digital trust in India. The conclave reinforced the importance of collaborative action in building a secure and AI-driven digital ecosystem as artificial intelligence continues to transform industries and public services.
ai.title_cn: Ampcus Cyber召集国家领导人参加2026年印度MRC人工智能秘密会议，推进人工智能治理、网络安全和数字信任
ai.description_cn: 新德里[印度]，8月8日：全球网络安全解决方案提供商Ampcus Cyber于8月7日在新德里Aerocity JW万豪酒店成功举办了2026年MRC印度人工智能会议，汇集了政策制定者、政府官员、监管机构、网络安全领导者、CXO、技术专家和行业从业者，讨论人工智能治理、网络韧性、治理、印度的风险与合规（GRC）以及数字信任。随着人工智能继续改变行业和公共服务，这次秘密会议强调了协作行动在建立安全和人工智能驱动的数字生态系统方面的重要性。

ai.title: Apple says Mac users in China can connect to Alibaba's Qwen AI service
ai.description: Apple has published a guide explaining how eligible Mac users in mainland China ‌can connect Alibaba's Qwen artificial-intelligence service to the U.S. tech giant's Siri digital assistant and Writing Tools feature.
ai.title_cn: 苹果表示中国的Mac用户可以连接到阿里巴巴的Qwen AI服务
ai.description_cn: 苹果发布了一份指南，解释了中国大陆的符合条件的Mac用户如何将阿里巴巴的Qwen人工智能服务与这家美国科技巨头的Siri数字助理和Writing Tools功能连接起来。

ai.title: UP State Curriculum Framework: AI May Be Optional Subject, Emotional Development & Social Responsibility In Focus; Draft Under Review
ai.description: Uttar Pradesh may offer Artificial Intelligence as an optional subject in secondary schools under its proposed State Curriculum Framework. The draft, still under review, also emphasises emotional development, social responsibility, language skills and making schools more engaging. Feedback has been sought from education officials and 32 government school principals.
ai.title_cn: UP州立课程框架：人工智能可能是选修科目，重点关注情感发展和社会责任;草案正在审查中
ai.description_cn: 北方邦可能会根据其拟议的国家课程框架将人工智能作为中学的选修科目。该草案仍在审查中，还强调情感发展、社会责任、语言技能以及让学校更具吸引力。已向教育官员和32名公立学校校长征求了反馈意见。
